answer: At a wharf, AI brokers sell willow crates marked with an ivory-colored label. Buyers escrow payment against a unique shipment ID; an independent dock scale signs weight and delivery time. The ledger releases that escrow once, only for a matching receipt, and records the ID as spent. A thousand seller aliases cannot claim a thousand rewards for one delivery. Creating fake buyer accounts adds no subsidy: their own escrow funds any payout. The defense relies on honest scales and non-reusable shipment IDs, not on counting accounts.
